newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Aug retail sales value falls 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Irish Aug retail sales value falls 0.5 pct.

text.p: The value of Irish retail sales fell a provisional seasonally adjusted 0.5 percent in August, giving a year-on-year increase of 7.1 percent, Central Statistics Office (CSO) data showed on Friday.
In July, the value of sales fell a final 0.8 percent for a year-on-year rise of 7.4 percent, revised from last month's provisional figures showing a fall of 0.7 percent month-on-month.
Sales volume in July was down 0.8 percent on June and was 5.4 percent higher than in July last year.
